research_features.observation: The first 15:25 push faded. A second acceleration began around 15:33-15:34; SPY briefly crossed the $770 round level at 15:38 as call volume accelerated. The stock closed that minute below the independently estimated session VWAP.
research_features.hypothesis_for_miss: The bullish setup rules may have rejected a below-VWAP, below-open recovery as too small on an ATR basis. The exact live blocker cannot be confirmed from aggregate logs without the saved decision rows.

provenance.measurement_limit: The $0.20 and $0.42 figures are separate minute trade prints, not a verified entry ask and executable exit bid. The 15:25-to-15:38 path included a fall to $0.11.
